## Requirements
Requirement id to satisfy + stamp: **R-2.2.1** (§5a.1) — the event store / run ledger.
Stage-1 slice (§5a.1 §10; ticket goal): envelope + id model, `open_run`/`acquire_writer`/
`renew`/`release`/`append`/`read`/`head`/`subscribe`/`put_blob`/`get_blob`,
`project(context_view, run_summary)`, the C0 class set (lifecycle + model + action incl.
effect phases + `security.permission.*`), the single fenced writer, durable-before-visible,
the per-run hash chain, blob offload. Deferred by spec staging (NOT this ticket):
`fork`/`navigate`/`lineage`-navigation ops, `redact`/`gc`, signed checkpoints, `verify_rl`,
deterministic replay (Stage 2+); `control.*`/`measurement.*`/wildcard class families land
with their owning producers.

## Acceptance criteria
Gating (§5a.1 §8), deterministic: AC-R-2.2.1-{1,3,5,7,8,10,11,12,14}.
- AC-1: append-only; `verify` detects byte change; no op mutates/removes durable events.
- AC-3: delete views/indexes, rebuild from log+blobs ⇒ identical `view_hash`.
- AC-5: 100% of events carry participant_class/observability_level/schema_version/producer/
  lease_generation; observability coverage as a metric-registry field.
- AC-7: no durable event exceeds its class threshold; blob dedup (same bytes ⇒ same addr).
- AC-8: golden fixtures of every prior schema version load; newer dialect → SchemaMismatch;
  field removal requires recorded deprecation.
- AC-10: seq dense/strictly increasing; parent refs acyclic; every cross-run EventRef
  resolves.
- AC-11: two writers cannot both append; fenced writer → Fenced, event absent,
  `lifecycle.lease.fenced` audited.
- AC-12: streaming deltas, `requested{rendering}`, executor chunks appear on `subscribe`,
  never in `read`; one declared persistence table.
- AC-14: golden corpus — canonical bytes of a fixed event set + head hash byte-identical.

## Plan
1. `hh-provenance`: canonical `from_json` decoders for `ProvenanceRecord`/`Label`/
   `LabelEndorsed`/`EndorsementBasis`/`ContentKind` (CC8 additive; the ledger's
   canonical-seam decode and the monitor check-5 wiring need them — CC7 keeps the
   parse at the schema source, not a third private copy).
2. New persistent crate `crates/hh-ledger` (deps: hh-wire, hh-identity, hh-provenance,
   hh-ontology): `errors` (the §8.1-named typed refusals + `Tampered`), `ids` (time-ordered
   idp/1-flavoured allocated ids, `effect_id` derivation, injectable clock for the golden
   corpus), `manifest` (`RunManifest` record + `open_run` validation incl. run-kind rules,
   pinned-ref check → `UnresolvedRef`, lineage anchors), `classes` (the ONE declared
   persistence-policy table: durability, offload threshold, min observability, producers,
   audit-grade, kernel-origin, ephemeral fields, scope open/close rules), `event`
   (`EventEnvelope` + the spec field set), `schema` (envelope canonical form, version
   decode gate, deprecation registry), `store` (WAL with commit markers — durable-before-
   visible + torn-tail drop; the fenced writer lease persisted per run; `subscribe`
   frames; content-addressed blob store; `verify` → `Tampered{at_seq,kind}`; `lineage`),
   `views` (`context_view`, `run_summary`; `view_hash` over `(run_id, seq)` watermark +
   `view_policy_version`).
3. Hash construction (ADR-0029 §2, CC1 — `hh-identity`'s `idp_digest` is the one hasher):
   `hash = idp_id("ledger.event", 0x00 ‖ canonical(envelope − {hash}) ‖ prev_hash)`;
   `prev_hash` of seq 0 = `"genesis"` or the fork/continuation anchor's head hash.
4. Tests: unit per module; `tests/acceptance.rs` = the AC matrix incl. the golden
   corpus (`golden_transcript_is_byte_stable`) and the schema gate (`ac8_*`).

## Evidence report
**R-2.2.1 Stage-1 slice landed.** `hh-ledger` (new persistent crate) implements the
§5a.1 event store: `open_run` (seq-0 `lifecycle.run.created` + writer lease),
`acquire_writer`/`renew`/`release` (generation-fenced `lease.json`; `WouldBlock`,
`Fenced`, audited `lifecycle.lease.fenced`), `append` (atomic batch; dense `seq`;
schema/class/scope/parent/provenance/endorsement/kernel-origin gates; WAL lines +
commit marker + double `sync_all` = durable-before-visible; torn tail dropped on
replay), `read` (inclusive cursors, fwd/rev, `{plane,class,scope,ir_refs}` filter),
`head`, `subscribe` (`sync/durable/ephemeral/rewind/lagged/closed` frames; replay
unbounded, live channel bounded), `put_blob`/`get_blob` (`blob`-domain content
addresses, dedup, `Missing{reason}` never `Tampered`), `project` (`context_view`,
`run_summary` — pure folds stamped `(run_id, seq)` + `view_policy_version` +
`view_hash`), `verify` (`Tampered{at_seq,kind}` over 7 kinds), `lineage` (root-first
resolution; fork/continuation anchors verified at `open_run`). One declared class
table (81 rows: lifecycle + model + action incl. all 12 effect phases +
`security.permission.*` + `security.label.*` + `context.observation.recorded`);
ephemeral classes subscribe-only; `requested{rendering}` stripped to an ephemeral
fragment. Hash chain: `idp_id("ledger.event", 0x00 ‖ canonical(env−{hash}) ‖
prev_hash)`, genesis literal or lineage anchor. **Gating ACs all executable/green:**
AC-1,3,5,7,8,10,11,12,14 (test map in the matrix above). Provenance battery green
(missing/authority/text/taint/scope-ceiling/endorsement/attestation refusals).
Live verification n/a (offline-only, pure-logic library); no harness claim.
